enemy.name: 'Milan'
enemy.flavour_text: A domestic Originium Slug that escaped into the wild before mutating in a high-pressure environment. Despite its tremendous size and sturdy crystal back, it is not aggressive and extremely good at 'interacting' with people. It still views them the same way it did when it was merely a house pet, but what was once playful is now truly destructive at its new size.

abilities.text: When HP drops under half, gains greatly increased ATK and takes reduced Physical and Arts damage
Adds a Contaminated Mineral to the Deployment Waiting Zone (maximum of one)
Adds a Heat Cluster to the Preparation Area (When transferred, deals True damage to all allied units and Stuns them for several seconds)
